default/32356.htm.text: Jude: Our thanks to you! Because of your help, many of our people have found a new life. On the other hand, I hear that Darion's situation is rapidly deteriorating.

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-04.htm.text: Jude: Ah, these weapons are exquisite! I see that you brought me 200 weapons, just as you promised. You can exchange these 200 Evil Weapons for the S80 Grade weapon recipe , or if you prefer, I can give you 3 weapon pieces for every 5 Evil Weapons you have . What is your preference?

links.text: "I don't want to exchange them now."
"I want to exchange them for the S80 Grade weapon recipe."
"I want to exchange them for S80 Grade weapon pieces."

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-03.htm.text: Jude: Bear in mind that what I'm looking for are not run-of-the-mill weapons carried by common monsters within the Steel Citadel. No, I need weapons from the Lesser Evils and Greater Evils that are found in Monster Foundry . Other Evil Weapons are useless! Understand? Bring me 200 Evil Weapons and …

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-06.htm.text: Jude: Yes, I think you are capable of collecting the weapons. You can obtain the Evil Weapons from both the Lesser Evils and the Greater Evils in the Monster Foundry . Good luck!

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-07.htm.text: Jude: Well! Here it is. Do you like it? I doubt I will make a profit on this, after all. But your hard work deserves a reward. Here is the S80 Grade weapon recipe. Good luck!

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-07a.htm.text: Jude: You don't have enough Evil Weapons to get the S80 Grade weapon recipe. Bring me 200 Evil Weapons and I will exchange them for the S80 Grade weapon recipe . Keep at it!

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-08.htm.text: Jude: Ready to quit? Well, come back any time if you change your mind. You can always find me here, you know!

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-09.htm.text: Jude: Well! Here you are. And here are the S80 Grade weapon pieces as promised. Take them! If you collect more Evil Weapons, I'll be happy to provide you with the S80 Grade weapon recipe.

Q00690_JudesRequest/32356-09a.htm.text: Jude: You don't have enough Evil Weapons to get the S80 Grade weapon pieces I promised you. Bring me 5 Evil Weapons and I will give you 3 S80 Grade weapon pieces . Get back to work!
